notes: Extracted from a detailed Sound On Sound technical review (July 2014) that Grace Design hosts on its own site (gracedesign.com/press/pdf/grace-m905.pdf) — used in place of a bare spec sheet because it's the most complete connector-by-connector description available and is manufacturer-distributed; core facts (3x stereo XLR speaker outs, RCA unbalanced ins, 2x AES3 + S/PDIF(RCA+Toslink) + ADAT digital inputs, USB2 Type-B computer I/O, 15-pin D-Sub remote link, IEC power) are corroborated by B&H/Vintage King listings. This is the full-featured "m905" (rack unit + included desktop Remote Control Unit); Grace also sells an analog-only variant "m905 Analog" (M905-AN) that omits the entire digital section (AES3/S-PDIF/Toslink/ADAT/USB/wordclock) — do not conflate the two SKUs. Exact rear-panel silkscreen text (e.g. whether it reads "SPEAKER 1" vs "SPKR 1") is inferred from prose description, not from a labeled panel diagram, so port names are best-effort. No connector in this device's I/O falls on the SDI/HDMI/DP/RJ45 grading scales, so only the USB computer port carries a grade (usb-2.0, explicitly stated as "USB 2"/"Class-2 compliant"). ADAT's connector, the RCU link, and the firmware Mini-USB port all had to be mapped to the nearest available connector id (toslink, vga, usb-micro respectively) since the schema has no dedicated ADAT/D-Sub/Mini-USB ids — flagged individually in each port's note. Only the main rack-unit's own chassis I/O is modeled; the included RCU accessory panel duplicates a headphone jack and a firmware Mini-USB port but isn't treated as a separately cabled device.

ports.name: Sub/DAC/Meter Out L
ports.note: Configurable: subwoofer feed, direct D-A output, or meter feed

ports.name: Sub/DAC/Meter Out R
ports.note: Configurable: subwoofer feed, direct D-A output, or meter feed

ports.name: Talkback Out
ports.note: Mono line-level output of internal/external talkback mic

ports.name: Talkback Mic In
ports.note: External talkback mic input; switchable phantom power

ports.name: AES3 In 2
ports.note: AES3 inputs configurable as a dual-wire pair

ports.name: ADAT In
ports.note: Modeled as toslink (closest available id) — physically a TOSLINK-style optical connector carrying ADAT lightpipe/S-MUX, not S/PDIF

ports.name: USB 2 (Computer)
ports.note: Asynchronous Class-2 USB audio interface; 2-in/10-up or 2-in/2-out modes

ports.name: Remote (RCU)
ports.note: 15-pin D-Sub link to the included desktop remote-control unit (7m Mogami cable) — modeled as vga/DE-15 (closest available id); mechanically similar but a proprietary control/audio link, not VGA video

ports.name: Footswitch/Tally
ports.note: Combined footswitch input (talkback activation) and tally-light output on one 1/4" TRS jack

ports.name: USB (Firmware Update)
ports.note: Actual connector is Mini-USB Type-B, not Micro-USB; closest available id used. Used only for rack-unit firmware updates

ports.name: Headphone Out
ports.note: Front-panel 1/4" headphone jack; wired in parallel with the RCU headphone jack
